output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When minted, the balance of a target address is increased without a check, allowing the total supply to be arbitrarily increased, thus devaluing the token.
The transfer function has a wrong logic in the assertion function, allowing attackers to transfer tokens to any address.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing attackers to set the total supply to a very low value, devaluing the token.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing attackers to set the total supply to a very low value, devaluing the token.
The setPrices function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing attackers to set the buyPrice and sellPrice to a very large value, devaluing the token.
